content.title: ‘Euphoria’ season 3 returns tonight - How to watch for free
content.text: Colman Domingo and Zendaya in "Euphoria" season 3, which premieres on Sunday, April 12 on HBO (Photograph by Patrick Wymore/HBO)Patrick Wymore/HBOIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Ariana Tourangeau | atourangeau@masslive.comIt’s been four years since a new season of HBO’s Emmy-winning drama, “Euphoria,” was released, but tonight is the night. Season three will premiere with the first episode on Sunday, April 12, on HBO and HBO Max. Those without cable can watch the show for free through DIRECTV, which offers a free trial to new users. Sling and HBO Max are other options for streaming the show and promotional offers are available.The season three logline for the show is “a group of childhood friends wrestles with the virtue of faith, the possibility of redemption, and the problem of evil.”The group is transitioning into adulthood and is no longer in high school. The trailer shows Rue (Zendaya) being interrogated in Mexico after working with drug dealers, Cassie (Sweeney) and Nate (Elordi) getting married, and offers a glimpse of what the characters are doing post–high school.This season features the return of series regulars Emmy winner Zendaya, Hunter Schafer, Eric Dane, Golden Globe nominee Jacob Elordi, Emmy nominee Sydney Sweeney, Alexa Demie, Maude Apatow, Emmy nominee Martha Kelly, Chloe Cherry, Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje, and Toby Wallace. “Euphoria” was renewed for a third season in February 2022, but in March 2024, HBO announced that production on Season 3 had been indefinitely delayed. This season is extra emotional because two characters are no longer with us. Angus Cloud, who played Fezco on the show, passed away in July 2023 from an accidental overdose at the age of 25. Euphoria creator Sam Levinson told The Hollywood Reporter that the show will honor him in the upcoming season.According to the show’s trailer, Eric Dane made an appearance in the new season before his passing. The “Grey’s Anatomy” and “Euphoria” star died at the age of 53 on February 19. Dane died of respiratory failure, according to his death certificate obtained by PEOPLE. Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is an underlying cause of death. Dane’s death came less than a year after he announced his ALS diagnosis. Barbie Ferreira (Kat) and Austin Abrams are also not returning. Emmy winner Colman Domingo, GRAMMY nominee Dominic Fike, Nika King, Alanna Ubach, Sophia Rose Wilson, Melvin Bonez Estes, Daeg Faerch, Paula Marshall, Zak Steiner, and Marsha Gambles are returning for season 3.Below is a look at the new season from HBO’s YouTube Channel:Streaming ServiceStarting Monthly PriceFree TrialFree Trial LengthMax DiscountDIRECTV$89.99Yes5 days$40 off first monthHBO Max$10.99NoN/AN/ASling TV$45.99NoN/A$30 off first monthHow can I watch “Euphoria” without cable?Those without cable can watch the show on HBO for free through DIRECTV, which offers a free trial to new users.
